title: Oklahoma State University Extension — Diseases of Roses (EPP-7607)

common.preserved_uncertainty: "Prune out and burn all infected portions" and "a 10 percent dilution of household bleach" were found. The page's wording is "Disinfect pruning and cutting tools frequently", not the dossier's "after use on a diseased plant".
